descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT și Dezvoltare de software
We are seeking a skilled Senior Python Developer with Java experience to join our team on a long-term engagement for a leading client in the energy and critical infrastructure sector. The ideal candidate has solid experience building backend applications with Python , FastAPI and Kafka in a cloud-native environment, and is comfortable working on complex, high-reliability systems.
 The successful candidate will contribute to the development of a new modular control center platform, including monitoring and power-quality applications. The role covers the design, development, testing and documentation of new and existing software modules, in close collaboration with architects, engineers and other stakeholders.
 Engagement details: Full-time, 90% remote with occasional onsite presence in Berlin. Python is approximately 80% of the work and Java approximately 20% .
 Responsibilities: 
Design, implement, test and document new software modules according to defined requirements and acceptance criteria.
Enhance and further develop existing modules and system components.
Develop Python applications using FastAPI and Kafka-based streaming, and deploy them using Helm charts.
Develop and maintain Java components using Spring Boot.
Analyse existing third-party and open-source solutions, and provide documented make-or-buy recommendations including rationale, risks and benefits.
Prepare contributions to open-source components, including change descriptions, test evidence and publication readiness.
Produce technical designs that comply with the client's IT strategy and architecture standards.
Define and validate interfaces, dependencies and compatibility requirements across product lines.
Assess platform differences and adapt deployments to new infrastructure.
Evaluate and select additional data tools such as databases and streaming interfaces.
Prepare clear documentation and decision materials for stakeholder review.
Work in an agile team and contribute to continuous improvement of tools and processes.
 Requirements: 
 5+ years of professional experience developing IT solutions aligned with a client's IT strategy and standards.
Strong Python development experience (FastAPI, Kafka, Helm Charts) .
Solid Java development experience (Spring Boot, JDK 21+, Maven) .
Experience with agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
Good written and spoken English .
Verifiable project references showing the client, project period, your role and responsibilities, and a short description of your activities.
 Nice to have / Preferred Qualifications: 
Experience with Kubernetes, Argo CD, Protobuf, Pydantic and Grafana.
Electrical engineering background.
Experience with transmission system operators (TSOs) or comparable energy infrastructure companies.
Knowledge of SCADA, PMU, power quality (PQ), protection or fault recorder data.
Experience in critical infrastructure environments.
Ability to produce clear technical documentation and written decision materials.
 About Computacenter 
 Computacenter is a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate and public sector organisations. We are a responsible business that believes in sustainable long-term value creation.
 We help our customers to source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling people and their businesses.
 Computacenter plc is a public company quoted on the London Stock Exchange (CCC.L) and a member of the FTSE 100. Computacenter employs over 21,000 people worldwide.
